hook_stat.sub: Cut in the price of Bharat Biotech's malaria vaccine Mosqivac

stats.label: More children who could receive the full four-dose course
Expected savings for immunisation programmes between 2027 and 2029
Invested by GSK and Bharat Biotech in higher-output manufacturing

diaspora_bullets: Hyderabad-based Bharat Biotech manufactures Mosqivac, the first malaria vaccine the WHO recommended, in 2021
The lower price could fund full four-dose courses for up to one million more children
news_summary: Bharat Biotech has agreed an equitable pricing deal with Gavi and UNICEF that will cut the price of the world's first malaria vaccine by about 40 per cent.
payoff: GSK and Bharat Biotech aim to bring the price below $5 per dose by 2028.
